instructions: Commit and push any code changes.
Journal substantial decisions or rejections, citing item URLs or review IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

Set `$DISMISS_MESSAGE` to one sentence on what changed and run, even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_noloc --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"`
